basic_info.main_problem: 由于果汁吧生意清淡而产生的Anxiety与压力,使我相信我的生意会失败.
basic_info.core_demands: '我只是not想一直感到害怕和担心.我想感觉自己能对发生的事情有一些掌控.';'我not想每次遇到生意清淡就恐慌.我想在not假设最坏情况的前提下,觉得自己能应对一切.'
growth_experiences: 18岁Culinary school graduate后独自创业开设果汁吧;约一月前出现生意清淡的情况,此后not yet明显回升;在多次清淡日triggerPersistent anxiety与对失败的担忧,常联想到'会失去一切';曾尝试新的营销策略与促销,但not yet见显著成效;压力影响睡眠与饮食,注意力与Decline in work performance;与朋友关系因此紧张,尽管有一位支持的朋友,仍not yet向其谈及业务压力与Anxiety.

special_situations.event: Very few customers on business days(如上周几乎without人进店)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If business is slow one day, it means the overall trend is worsening and my business will eventually fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立刻高度关注生意数据,加倍投入以试图控制局面,同时not断担忧
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is the beginning of the business's end

special_situations.event: 实施新的营销与促销后仍not yet见显著改善
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果短期内看not到明显成效,就说明我的努力毫Meaninglessness,我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断更换策略,Anxiety地监测结果,用加倍努力来证明自己

special_situations.event: Multiple slow-business days within a month
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One or a few slumps can represent overall failure and long-term slump
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 持续担忧not yet来,减少与朋友交流以避免被问及或评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This means it will always be like this; I will keep being terrible

special_situations.event: 夜间因Sleep affected而独自反复思考生意前景
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法立刻找到解决方案,就表示我without法掌控局势,一切会变得更糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过not断担心与预演最坏情境来寻求控制感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have lost control; things will only get worse

core_conflict.wish: Longing for career success, stable financial security, and control over the situation
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败,害怕经济not安全以及失去投入的一切
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of failure by maintaining high vigilance and anticipating in advance
避免向他人求助以免暴露脆弱与not确定感

object_relations.self_representation: 被压力压迫,Anxiety且倾向独自承担的创业者
object_relations.object_representation: 朋友/他人被视为not宜麻烦或难以谈及压力的对象

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师提出use重构,现实检验等方法来改变思维模式或鼓励多角度Interpretation时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为'我很难改变思维',需要为without法改变或暂not尝试提供理由以缓解Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use犹疑且防御的语气,频繁use'很难''not确定''可能'等词,强调客观困难,礼貌地表达保留与顾虑.

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
